changelog:
Enhance media buffers, improve settings UI, and optimize streaming:
- Add buffered content visualization to audio/video seek sliders with progress event listeners
- Redesign global settings panel with improved layout and styling using new CSS classes
- Increase HLS buffer from 30MB to 40MB and buffer length from 30s to 60s
- Fix accent color restoration when disabling customizer
- Add enhance settings controls to persistent settings array
- Adjust UI spacing and add light theme support for new settings components
